verdict.rationale: Wrike's official developer portal says users can connect Wrike to Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio and other AI assistants via MCP. It also says those assistants can manage tasks, query projects and automate workflows through natural language, which meets the core of the story. However, the evidence is only marketing-level statements from the developer homepage. missing for 10: MCP server setup/endpoint documentation, list of exposed tools, MCP-specific auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
